report.intro: Seen sewage, foam, dumped waste or a blocked drain on the river? Send a photo. A team member checks every report before it appears on the map.
report.closed: Photo reports are not open yet. The team is testing this page first. Until then, you can use the map to see who is responsible for a spot.
report.not_ready: This page cannot send reports right now (the server address is missing). Please try again later.
report.tip.html: Tip: take the photo with the free GPS Map Camera app (search for it in your app store). It prints the exact location and time on the photo, which this page reads for you.
report.photo_error: This photo could not be opened. Please choose a JPEG photo, or take a screenshot of it and choose that.
report.photo_ready: Photo ready ({w} × {h}). The original never leaves your phone: only a resized copy without hidden data is sent.
report.stamp_reading: Reading the location printed on the photo…
report.stamp_found: Location read from the printed stamp: {lat}, {lng}.
report.stamp_none: No printed location found on this photo.
report.stamp_failed: The printed location could not be read. Set the pin on the map instead.
report.read_stamp: Read the location printed on my photo
report.read_stamp_size: Downloads about 3 MB the first time.
report.exif_found: Location found in the photo's hidden data.
report.faces_help: Faces are blurred on your phone before the photo is sent. A team member checks every photo and blurs anything else private (a face we missed, a number plate) before it is published.
report.faces_finding: Looking for faces… (downloads about 2.5 MB the first time)
report.faces_unavailable: Automatic face finding does not work on this phone. The team will blur any faces before publishing.
report.place_help: Tap the map or drag the pin to the exact spot. Reports are accepted inside the outlined areas.
report.location_asking: Asking your phone for its location…
report.location_denied: Your phone did not share its location. Set the pin on the map instead.
report.pin_none: No pin yet. Tap the map at the spot.
report.out_of_zone: This place is outside the areas we cover for now (outlined on the map), so the report cannot be sent.
report.note: Anything else the team should know (optional)
report.note_help: Please don't write names, phone numbers or emails.
report.consent: I took this photo or may share it. I agree it can be published on this site after the team checks it.
report.missing.pin: set the pin on the map
report.missing.zone: move the pin inside an outlined area
report.missing.faces: wait for the face check to finish
report.done_title: Thank you. Your report is in.
report.done_next: A team member will check it. If it is approved, it appears on the map as a resident report (not yet verified by the team). Keep the reference if you want to ask about it.
report.keep.html: Your photo (after blurring, resized, without hidden phone data), the place you confirm, when the photo was taken, the problem and your note. Never your name, phone number or email. Your internet address is used only in scrambled form to limit spam, and is deleted after 2 days. Photos stay private until a team member checks them; the team blurs anything else private, publishes only that cleaned copy, and deletes the photo you sent. Privacy page.
report.err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few minutes.

report.err.not_configured: Reports are switched off on the server right now. Please try again later.
report.err.origin_not_allowed: Reports can only be sent from this website.
report.err.too_large: The photo is too large. Please try a smaller photo.
report.err.bad_form: The report could not be read. Please reload the page and try again.
report.err.bad_report: The report could not be read. Please reload the page and try again.
report.err.spam_check_missing: The spam check did not finish. Please wait a moment and send again.
report.err.spam_check_expired: The spam check expired. Please send again.
report.err.spam_check_failed: The spam check failed. Please send again.
report.err.spam_check_reused: This report was already sent once. Reload the page to send a new one.
report.err.rate_hour: You have sent 3 reports in the last hour. Please wait a while before sending more.
report.err.rate_day: You have sent 10 reports today. Thank you! Please send more tomorrow.
report.err.rate_site: The site has received the most reports it can take today. Please try again tomorrow.
report.err.no_location: Set the pin on the map first.
report.err.outside_report_zones: The pin is outside the areas we cover for now.
report.err.unknown_problem_type: Please choose the problem from the list.
report.err.unknown_location_source: The location could not be read. Please set the pin again.
report.err.note_too_long: The note is too long (500 characters at most).
report.err.bad_date: The photo's date could not be read.
report.err.future_date: The photo's date is in the future. Check your phone's date and time.
report.err.not_jpeg_or_webp: This phone made a photo type the server does not accept. Please try another browser.
report.err.too_many_pixels: The photo is too large. Please try again.
report.err.has_hidden_data: The photo still had hidden data, so it was not sent. Please try another browser.
report.err.unreadable: The photo could not be read. Please choose another photo.
review.title: Review reports
review.subtitle: Review of resident reports (team only)
review.sign_in_failed: Wrong email or password, or this account does not exist.
review.not_reviewer: This account is not a reviewer. Ask Pranav to add it (supabase/README.md, "Adding a reviewer").
review.not_ready: The review page is not set up (the Supabase address or key is missing in config.js).
review.tools_help: Drag on the photo to blur an area. Tap a box to switch its blur on or off. Yellow = blurred, white dashed = not blurred, orange dashed = a suggestion you must decide.
review.faces_failed: Face finding did not work in this browser. Check for faces by eye.
review.plates_finding: Looking for number plates… (downloads about 10 MB the first time)
review.plates_found: {n} possible number plate(s) or vehicle lettering found ({s} s). Decide each one below.
review.plates_failed: Plate finding did not work in this browser. Check for number plates by eye.
review.wait_finding: Wait for the face and plate check to finish.
review.undecided: Decide the {n} orange suggestion(s) before approving.
review.ready: Ready: {n} area(s) will be blurred in the published photo. Look over the whole photo once more.
review.flag.pin_far_from_stamp: pin more than 200 m from the printed stamp
review.flag.pin_far_from_photo_gps: pin more than 200 m from the photo's GPS
review.flag.pin_far_from_device: pin far from the phone's location
review.flag.pin_only: placed by hand, no location evidence
review.flag.old_photo: photo taken more than 90 days ago
review.flag.note_has_contact: the note seems to contain a phone number or email
review.note: Resident's note (remove names, numbers or emails before approving)
review.reason_needed: Choose a reason for rejecting first.
review.already_decided: Another reviewer has already decided this report.
review.done.approved: {ref} approved and published. The original is deleted.
review.done.needs_visit: {ref} marked for a team visit. It stays private.
review.footer: Approving publishes a cleaned copy and deletes the original. Rejecting deletes the original. "Needs a team visit" keeps it private until the visit.
rr.label: Resident report
rr.legend: Resident report (not verified by the team)
rr.unverified: Sent by a resident and checked by a team member. The team has not visited this spot yet.
rr.photo_caption: Photo sent by a resident; faces and number plates blurred by the team. Tap to see it larger.
rr.mention_ref: You can mention the reference {ref}: the photo stays on this site for the office to see.
rr.flag_help: If it still shows a face, a number plate or other private details, report it. It is taken off the site at once, and a team member checks it again.
rr.flag_done: Thank you. The photo has been taken off the site, and a team member will check it again.
rr.flag_error.rate_day: You have reported several photos today. Please try again tomorrow.
rr.flag_error.rate_site: Many photos were reported today. Please try again tomorrow.
rr.flag_error.network: Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
rr.flag_error.not_ready: Reporting photos is not available yet.
rr.flag_error.server_error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
rr.recent_help: Each one was checked by a team member before it appeared here. The team has not yet visited these spots.
flag.reason.plate: A number plate can be read
flag.reason.personal: Other private details (a name, phone number or house)
flag.reason.not_pollution: It is not a pollution problem
review.tick: I checked the whole photo, including the background: no recognisable face, number plate or other private detail is left unblurred.
review.tick_needed: {n} area(s) will be blurred. Check the whole photo, then tick the box above to approve.
review.flagged_fact: {reason}, {when}. The photo was taken off the site. Approve it again only after fixing what is wrong.
